adjudications.rationale: The prompt follows eTable 1, which states the toxicity outcome definition was not reported, and the article abstract reports grade 3/4 adverse-event rates of 43% and 14%. The proposal identifies the same two randomized arms using equivalent arm names, endpoint, and values. Its treatment-exposed safety denominators (627 and 629) refine the more general safety-population wording in the frozen scope. “Grade 3/4 adverse events” is shorter than the prompt definition but is the exact severity-specific abstract result frozen for this case; the proposal relation narrower reflects the selected result within the broader adverse-event concept.
